checks.message: No expected settings are catalogued for imap.thundermail.com. Covered so far: Thundermail.
Thundermail uses one server name for everything: mail.thundermail.com. There is no separate imap., smtp. or pop. host, so a name like this will not resolve.
checks.remediation: Set Server Name to mail.thundermail.com, for both incoming and outgoing mail.
checks.provenance: pulumi/config.prod.yaml in thunderbird/thunderbird-accounts and the published SRV records both point at the single host mail.thundermail.com. Derived from configuration, not from an observed support case.
